name: RJ45 (8P8C) patch-cable plug with strain-relief boot
build: blender -b --factory-startup --python source/build_rj45_plug.py, then glTF-Transform dedup → weld → meshopt
units: metres; origin at the SEAT POINT (the port face when fully home); tip 13.5 mm ahead along -Z in three.js
fit: made to generic-router-5port's jack: body above the port centre by 1.34 mm, latch in the notch below

anchors.cable: where the cable leaves the boot: a scene draws the cable from here

moving_parts.plug_latch: hinged at the tip end; rotate about X toward 0 to press it

cable: not in the asset: OE3D.Cable draws a tube from anchor_cable along the scene's own path

provenance.origin: original work, authored for OE by the explainer engine (procedural Blender script)
provenance.creator: OE Support explainer engine
